# PASA Sentinel (Private Android Security Agent)
> Sovereign Android Mobile Defense & Covert Anti-Theft System (Android 8.0 – 16)
> Domain: https://pasa.izhaanintellect.fun/
> Official Repository: https://github.com/rbr48/pasa

PASA Sentinel is an enterprise-grade sovereign mobile defense and anti-theft operating system for Android devices. It operates without Google Play Services or cloud dependencies, enforcing Knox-grade uninstallation lockout, headless forensic capture, and air-gapped cellular SMS command authority.

## Core Architectural Guarantees

- **Zero-Data Architecture (v3.6.0):** Absolute customer privacy sovereignty. Private Telegram Bot Tokens and Chat IDs NEVER leave the Android device and are NEVER transmitted to or stored on any central VPS. The device communicates directly and exclusively with Telegram's official API servers (`api.telegram.org`) in Sovereign Mode.
- **Anonymous Hashed Licensing & 7-Day Rotating Ed25519 Certificates:** License activation and status checks use an irreversible one-way SHA-256 device hash (`SHA-256(deviceId:key)`), completely obscuring raw physical hardware IDs. Verified offline via 7-day rotating Ed25519 cryptographic certificates that support instant revocation without maintaining invasive persistent tracking databases.
- **100% Zero Cloud Storage (Strategy 1):** Zero surveillance photos, zero ambient audio recordings, zero video clips, and zero GPS tracking histories are stored on VPS hard drives or company databases. All surveillance evidence is transmitted directly from device RAM to the user's private encrypted Telegram bot via HTTPS and is immediately shredded locally from phone RAM.
- **Knox-Grade Device Owner Permanence:** Configured as Android Enterprise Device Owner (`dpm`). Android itself permanently grays out 'Uninstall' and 'Force Stop' buttons ('Managed by your organization'). Blocks Safe Mode restarts, recovery menu factory resets, and notification shade pulldowns.
- **Hardware Escrow Tokens (Android 8.0 – 16):** Overcomes Android 14+ password reset deprecation using 32-byte cryptographic hardware escrow tokens to remotely reset lockscreen PINs over the air.
- **Hardware USB Data Pin Killswitch (Android 12+):** Physically severs USB data pin signaling (`setUsbDataSignalingEnabled(false)`), neutralizing forensic extraction boxes (Cellebrite, GrayKey) and BadUSB attacks while preserving AC power charging.
- **Autonomous Sensor Traps:** Kinetic Snatch Detection (2.65G accelerometer trigger), Pocket & Bag Extraction Trap, Charger Disconnect Trap, and SIM Ejection Knox Kiosk Lockdown with Foreign SIM Caller ID Trap.
- **Armed Coercion Duress Sandbox:** Entering a secret Decoy Duress PIN instantly vanishes banking, crypto, and private messaging apps into a sterile dummy environment while silently snapping the perpetrator's mugshot and transmitting an emergency GPS fix.
- **Air-Gapped Cellular SMS Fallback:** Full remote control authority when Wi-Fi, cellular data, and Location are turned off. Authenticated via RFC 6238 TOTP tokens or Master Cryptographic PIN with dual-SIM return routing.

## 4 Deployment Pathways (No PC Required Options)

1. **Zero-Touch Enterprise QR (Phone Only):** On an unboxed or factory-reset phone, tap 6 times on the Android "Welcome / Hi there" screen to launch the hidden Enterprise QR scanner. Scan the official QR code to download, verify, and provision Knox Device Owner automatically without any computer.
2. **1-Click WebADB (Browser USB):** Connect via USB in Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge and execute Device Owner provisioning directly over WebUSB without downloading platform-tools.
3. **Wireless ADB / OTG (Phone Only):** Pair on-device using LADB (Android 11–16) or connect via Type-C OTG cable to a second Android phone using Bugjaeger.
4. **Windows Setup Kit:** 6-step guided automated PowerShell wizard for Windows 10/11.
